snippet.title: Might & Magic Duel of Champions: Forgotten Wars - Launch trailer | PS3
snippet.description:
Enter the legendary universe of Might & Magic Duel of Champions: Forgotten Wars, the strategic card collectible game now available for console gamers. Choose a hero and assemble an army of creatures to battle against fierce opponents. 

For more information visit: https://duelofchampions.com/en/game/console
